scope: deduplicated ORB-v23 post-init mechanism search across AQUALOC and NTNU
repeat_interpretation: four runtime repeats are deterministic reproducibility checks, not independent windows
project_strict_rule: full must improve reconstructed and online APE/RPE against native/drop with stable action and no metric conflict; the unbounded shadow is a causal comparison
audit_strict_rule: for every repeat, full must be lower than native/drop and full_unbounded on reconstructed and online APE/RPE
window_deduplication: selector variants and rearm variants from the same image interval count once
legacy_label_note: A10 2400-2800 is retained as a stable project-level ORB positive, but is aggregate-positive rather than repeatwise strict because full beats full_unbounded in 3/4 repeats
